title: Donation Tax-Receipt Readiness
dataSources: Volunteer shifts (`volunteer:shift`), donations (`donation:gift`), community events (`community:event`), mutual-aid requests (`mutualaid:request`), impact metrics (`impact:metric`).
app: Volunteering and community telemetry — volunteer-hours trackers, donation receipts, mutual-aid request boards, and community-event calendars — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=donation:gift
| stats sum(amount) as total, sum(eval(if(receipt="yes",1,0))) as with_receipt, count as gifts
| eval missing_receipts=gifts-with_receipt
description: Totals your deductible giving for the year and flags gifts still missing a receipt before tax time.
value: Chasing receipts in advance turns a stressful tax scramble into a simple, complete record.
implementation: Ingest donations into `index=personal`; total giving and flag missing receipts.
visualization: Summary panel of annual giving and missing receipts.
grandmaExplanation: It adds up your charitable giving for the year and flags any gifts still missing a receipt for tax time.
